title: Reference-Free Post-Training of Open Large Language Models for Multilingual Machine Translation
abstract: arXiv:2608.10812v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study reference-free post-training for multilingual machine translation with open large language models. Starting from the supervised-finetuned MiLMMT-46-v0.1 models, we apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a reward that averages two reference-free quality estimation models and is gated by language identification. We then linearly interpolate the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) model checkpoints to obtain MiLMMT-46-v1.0. Across 46 languages, the resulting models consistently improve translation quality over their SFT counterparts, outperform strong recent open baselines, including Seed-X, HY-MT2, and TranslateGemma, and achieve leading reference-free scores against evaluated proprietary systems such as Google Translate, Gemini 3 Pro, and GPT-5. translated_title: 开放大型语言模型的无参考后训练用于多语言机器翻译
translated_abstract: 我们研究了使用开放大型语言模型进行多语言机器翻译的无参考后训练。从监督微调的MiLMMT-46-v0.1模型开始，我们应用组相对策略优化（GRPO），其奖励函数是两种无参考质量评估模型的平均值，并通过语言识别进行门控。然后，我们对监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）模型检查点进行线性插值，得到MiLMMT-46-v1.0。在46种语言中，所得模型持续提高了翻译质量，优于其SFT对应版本，超过了包括Seed-X、HY-MT2和TranslateGemma在内的近期强开放基线，并在与Google Translate、Gemini 3 Pro和GPT-5等专有系统的评估中取得了领先的无参考分数。我们进一步研究了策略内蒸馏（OPD），发现它达到了但未超越由RL实现的质量前沿。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无参考后训练方法，通过GRPO和模型插值显著提升开放大模型的多语言翻译质量，在46种语言上超越现有开放和专有系统。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reference-free post-training method using GRPO and model interpolation to significantly improve multilingual translation quality of open large models, outperforming existing open and proprietary systems across 46 languages.
